name: parallax-depth-cards
title: Parallax Depth Cards
description: A trio of floating cards translating at differential Z-depth velocities as the user interacts with the container.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Container Scroll Depth Parallax: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
